facts.text: The hotel sits on a hill beside Kiyomizu-dera Temple, embraced by a bamboo forest.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on a hill beside the renowned Kiyomizu-dera Temple and embraced by a tranquil bamboo forest, Banyan Tree Higashiyama Kyoto hotel offers an intimate retreat.

facts.text: The Bamboo Pavilion at the heart of the property was designed by architect Kengo Kuma and is a stage for classical performances.
facts.excerpt: At the heart of the property stands the Bamboo Pavilion, designed by renowned architect Kengo Kuma and the only authentic stage in any Kyoto hotel, where classical performances unfold

facts.text: The hotel is the only hotel in Kyoto with a traditional Noh theater stage, the Bamboo Pavilion.
facts.excerpt: It is the only hotel in Kyoto with a traditional Noh theater stage, “Bamboo Pavilion“, which is connected to its special location.

facts.text: The natural onsen is drawn from a hot spring on the hilltop grounds and can be enjoyed in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, in select rooms with a private onsen, and in the spa's treatment suites.
facts.excerpt: Drawn from a natural hot spring on the hilltop grounds, our Natural Onsen can be enjoyed in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, in select guest rooms with a private onsen, and in the spa's treatment suites.

facts.text: The onsen baths are gender-separated.
facts.excerpt: For a uniquely Kyoto experience, unwind in our gender-separated onsen, where warm, soothing waters restore mind, body, and soul.

facts.text: Rooms have tatami mat floors and garden or city views, with wooden soaking bathtubs, sitting areas and separate walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: natural hot springs, tatami mat floors and breathtaking garden or city views. Other amenities of our Kyoto hotel rooms include wooden soaking bathtubs, cozy sitting areas and separate walk-in showers.

facts.text: Onsen Retreat rooms have a private natural onsen and look onto a Japanese courtyard garden.
facts.excerpt: Set alongside a Japanese courtyard garden, the Onsen Retreats offers a rare Kyoto private onsen experience within a tranquil setting.

facts.text: Wellbeing Sanctuary King rooms have a private yoga space and floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate in luxury with our plush King bed and private yoga space. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal stunning city views while wooden soaking tubs enhance your wellness journey.

facts.text: The Banyan Onsen Retreat is the most spacious, at 74 square metres, with a private natural onsen.
facts.excerpt: This beloved Kyoto Onsen hotel room boasts an impressive 74 square metres of living space

facts.text: The spa offers a private onsen experience in treatment rooms with traditional hinoki cypress bathtubs.
facts.excerpt: As you soak in the traditional hinoki cypress bathtub, breathe in the gentle, naturally aromatic fragrance that emanates from the wood

facts.text: The Onsen Indulgence treatment, exclusive to this spa, combines a private onsen experience with a full-body treatment.
facts.excerpt: A Banyan Tree Spa Higashiyama Kyoto exclusive, this combination of a private onsen experience and a full-body treatment restores your vitality

facts.text: The spa has natural hot springs and steam saunas.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in tranquil massage and spa facilities with natural hot springs and steam saunas.

facts.text: Geiko and maiko perform traditional dance with shamisen music against the backdrop of the hotel's Noh stage.
facts.excerpt: Experience the refined artistry of skilled geiko and maiko performing traditional dance accompanied by shamisen music against the backdrop of a historic Noh stage.

facts.text: Noh performances are staged with masks illuminated by candlelight.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the ethereal world of Noh, where haunting drum rhythms and mystical masks illuminated by candlelight create an unforgettable encounter

facts.text: Guided morning yoga is held overlooking the Japanese gardens.
facts.excerpt: Guided by our instructors, experience morning yoga overlooking Japanese gardens, restoring balance to body and mind

facts.text: The hotel has a bamboo garden of towering bamboo groves.
facts.excerpt: Step into our enchanting bamboo garden, where towering bamboo groves create a natural sanctuary of tranquility in the heart of Kyoto.

facts.text: Ryozen, set beside the Bamboo Pavilion, offers kaiseki courses or counter dining with chefs cooking over the grill.
facts.excerpt: Guests may choose from refined kaiseki courses or immersive counter dining, where chefs prepare each course with quiet precision over the grill.

facts.text: Bar Ryozen serves local sake, including from nearby Fushimi.
facts.excerpt: Flavourful expressions from nearby Fushimi and other regions shine the spotlight on traditional Japanese sakes

facts.text: Ryozen SEN Bettei is a branch of Japanese Cuisine SEN serving creative kaiseki at a counter overlooking Higashiyama.
facts.excerpt: A cozy branch of the highly acclaimed “Japanese Cuisine SEN.” Enjoy creative kaiseki cuisine at a quiet counter seat overlooking the Higashiyama area.

facts.text: Kansai International Airport is the nearest airport; from Kyoto Station it is about 20 minutes by taxi.
facts.excerpt: From Kyoto Station, it takes about 20 minutes by taxi to reach the hotel.

facts.text: Valet parking is not available and parking reservations are not accepted.
facts.excerpt: (Valet service is not available.)

facts.text: Ryozen SEN Bettei is closed on Wednesdays and requires reservations two days in advance.
facts.excerpt:
Closed: Wednesday
/Reservation required at two days in advance.

facts.text: The hotel has a gym equipped with the latest exercise equipment.
facts.excerpt: Keep up your daily routine in our gym equipped with the latest exercise equipment.

facts.text: The hotel was awarded One MICHELIN Key in 2026 for the second consecutive year.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Higashiyama Kyoto Awarded One MICHELIN Key in 2026 for the Second Consecutive Year.
